run_interactive_chat: run an interactive CLI chat with the Claude Agent SDK using LiteLLM as a proxy gateway
run_main_entry: run the main entry point that starts the async interactive chat loop with keyboard interrupt handling
configure_claude_agent_options: configure ClaudeAgentOptions with a system prompt, model name, and max turns for the agent
use_claude_sdk_client: use ClaudeSDKClient as an async context manager to create and manage agent conversation sessions
stream_agent_response: stream the agent response from the ClaudeSDKClient for a given user input message
